name: io.github.orifisher2/sqlike-mcp
description: Deterministic SQL static analysis and query-equivalence checking for Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, SQL Server, and DuckDB. No LLM in the analysis path; queries are tokenized locally before they are sent.

environmentVariables.name: SQLIKE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for the sqlike backend (higher rate limits).
